name: Hana Tsubaki
source:
"I really don't know how to respond to that."

Tsubaki is a third year student from Class B. She works as a miko at the shrine located in the center of the town. She plays an important role in the annual Magui Festival held in summer and is treated with respect by the townspeople.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/hobe_0406/]DMM[/url] and the [url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/mojika/]official website[/url]]
